schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh state Government started a scheme "Medhavi Chhatr/ Chhatra Shiksha Protsahan Yojana" for education.

children.text: Chhattisgarh "Medhaavee Chhaatr/ Chhaatra Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana" has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh and operated by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh. Benefits will be provided to applicants studying in 10th, 12th, graduation, post graduation, and some selected courses.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Chhattisgarh "Medhaavee Chhaatr/ Chhaatra Shiksha Protsaahan Yojana" has been started by the Government of Chhattisgarh and operated by the Labor Department of Chhattisgarh. Benefits will be provided to applicants studying in 10th, 12th, graduation, post graduation, and some selected courses.
